cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/organize_refs.sh
#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Store package files (these define or implement store.Memo) ==="
echo "store"
echo ""
echo "=== Store sub-packages (database drivers) ==="
echo "store/db/mysql"
echo "store/db/postgres"
echo "store/db/sqlite"
echo ""
echo "=== External packages that reference store.Memo ==="

grep -r "\bMemo\b" /bench/repo --include="*.go" | grep -v "\.pb\.go" | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | while read file; do
    # Exclude store package and its subpackages
    if [[ "$file" != "/bench/repo/store"* ]]; then
        # Extract package path from file
        package_dir=$(dirname "$file")
        # Normalize to relative path from repo
        package_rel=${package_dir#/bench/repo/}
        echo "$package_rel"
    fi
done | sort -u
EOF
bash /tmp/organize_refs.sh

#!/bin/bash

# Core store package that defines Memo
echo "github.com/usememos/memos/store"
echo ""

# Store sub-packages implementing the driver interface
echo "github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/mysql"
echo "github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/postgres"
echo "github.com/usememos/memos/store/db/sqlite"
echo ""

# External packages that reference store.Memo (excluding auto-generated proto files)
grep -r "\bMemo\b" /bench/repo --include="*.go" | grep -v "\.pb\.go" | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | while read file; do
    # Exclude store package and its subpackages
    if [[ "$file" != "/bench/repo/store"* ]]; then
        # Exclude proto-generated files
        if ! head -1 "$file" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Code generated"; then
            # Extract package path from file
            package_dir=$(dirname "$file")
            # Normalize to relative path from repo
            package_rel=${package_dir#/bench/repo/}
            echo "github.com/usememos/memos/$package_rel"
        fi
    fi
done | sort -u
EOF
bash /tmp/final_refs.sh
